scientific_standard: Internal proof and finite diagnostics distinguished from external validation, priority and readiness.

claims.title: Indexed sparse exact hypoexponential clock
claims.statement: Independent geometric extras followed by one common-rate gamma sample give the full sum-of-exponentials law; expected indexed rate queries k q_star.
boundaries: Certified tight endpoint envelope is acquired/charged.
Ideal real/random-variate model; no end-to-end exact-bit implementation.
Gamma series and uniformization laws are classical.

claims.title: Exact one-binomial fixed-time cutoff
claims.statement: Given latent extras and root total H, Binomial(A-1,u/H) microphase arrivals and one sparse scan give the exact joint prefix law in expected O(1) work.
boundaries: Exact bounded-cost binomial primitive explicitly assumed.
Multiple cut times require joint allocation.
Cost is unconditional per attempted block, not uniformly conditioned on rare overshoots.

claims.title: Corrected CRN fixed-time complexity
claims.statement: Expected work O(I_net+(D(n_max)+1)(1+rho E L_t/sqrt(n_min))) under corrected uniformization and content/slowdown/population interfaces.
boundaries: Unconditional population promise or justified stopped-run contract.
Passive-event slowdown rho remains.
Compressed output only; full trajectory output is linear.
Source discrete batching routine imported and charged.

claims.title: Source catalyst factorial mismatch
claims.statement: Under the source binomial propensity convention, the printed falling-factorial catalyst normalization scales a delta-padded propensity by 1/delta!.
boundaries: Repair is k V^delta/binom(m,delta).
No upstream edit or author contact.
Does not refute the clock law.

claims.title: Occupation-based whole-visible-path certificate
claims.statement: For frozen predictor/controller, path TV <= delta_init+T sqrt((k-1)D), with D acquired by reset/random-stop compatible-gain moment experiments.
boundaries: Physical product gain/neutrality or all-event sensing is an actual interface.
Finite-confidence bounds may be large.
On-policy finite horizon only.
D includes conditional hidden-rate variance; good visible models can fail certificate.

claims.title: Matched active/passive certification separation
claims.statement: A four-label hidden prefix-tree family has exponential passive reset testing cost and polynomial active certification under specified geometric gains.
boundaries: Hidden dimension exponential in context length.
Stronger active interface disclosed.
No generic physical advantage or tolerant-testing claim.
Birthday lower-bound mechanism is established.

claims.title: Exact rational graded observable inverse
claims.statement: Acquired strictly graded generator relations with factorial coefficient bounds give a bounded Poisson inverse and exact rational unbiased local-walk evaluation.
boundaries: Closure acquisition and row arithmetic charged.
Within-grade extension needs absolute damping and work bounds.
Does not compute arbitrary stationary distributions.
Random Neumann evaluation is classical.

claims.title: One-sided phase feedback response
claims.statement: Arbitrary directed P with shared Brownian phase and one-sided copy multipliers has sharp response Theta(gamma^-1/3), expected row work O(gamma^-1/3), second moment O(gamma^-2/3).
boundaries: Modified dynamics, not an inverse for the original chain.
One-sided Fourier/Hill and cubic dephasing mechanisms are prior.
Consequential physical application remains absent.

claims.title: Signed phase feedback response
claims.statement: Fair independent conjugate copy multipliers yield sharp response Theta(gamma^-1/2), expected row work O(gamma^-1/2), second moment O(gamma^-1).
boundaries: Random charge diffusion required.
Deterministic cancelling two-cycle instead gives inverse gamma scale.
Mathieu/harmonic-oscillator and duality mechanisms are prior.
No physical capability established.

claims.title: Relative capacity/resolvent transfer

boundaries: Model, within-label gap and inequalities must be acquired.
Schur complement is not automatically a Markov generator.
No novelty or generic rare-rate measurement shortcut.

claims.title: High-drive hidden-block identification

boundaries: No transient or full inverse recovery result.
No uncharged high-drive advantage.

claims.title: Quantum history occupation/purification route
claims.statement: Orthogonal history ranges improve a guarded-lift threshold; an acquired full exact chart permits purification.
boundaries: Exact recurrence/occupation merge/decoder circuit not acquired.
Truncation does not imply exact physical kernel support.

claims.title: Finite-word Fourier catalyst extension

boundaries: Global implementation/source assumptions not fully closed.
No stable arbitrary-length DFT or practical crossover claim.

claims.title: Civilization-scale original foundational capability
claims.statement: No completed result meets the mission's exceptional original scientific/technological capability standard.
boundaries: Internal proofs/diagnostics do not establish priority, experimental effect or readiness.

claims.title: Conditional-variance acquisition obstruction
claims.statement: Six-label episodic family with known generator/probes and unknown repeatable preparation requires Omega(2^(m/2)) resets to acquire conditional hazard error with perfect-predictor completeness, despite T=O(m) and inverse accuracy O(m).
boundaries: Hidden context count and alternative description exponential in m.
Even full context/sign observation per reset is insufficient before collisions.
No lower bound against known small conditional closure or native independent posterior replicas.
Birthday and conditional-testing principles are established.
